Relief shown by hachures. Hand colored. Published in the 1795 ed. of Thomas Jefferys' West-India atlas. First published by Robert Sayer for the 1775 ed. of the same work. Three copies. Copy 1, colored in greens. Copy 2, colored in oranges. Copy 3, colored in pinks. Includes inset of "Plan of Fort Amsterdam" and profiles of relief. Scale ca. 1:120,000. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. Vault AACR2
